concepts.gloss_en: not in order / out of sequence — the disruption of divine order (reverse alphabet tashrak, opposition of will, war) in LM2:82

reason_for_human: All 5 occurrences are in the same lesson (LM2:82) and all express the identical idea 'שֶׁלֹּא כְּסֵדֶר' (not in order) — the disruption of order tied to the reverse alphabet, opposition of will, war, and sickness. The 'לא כסדר' form is just the same phrase captured with/without the ש prefix, not a different word. Clean single concept, no homograph risk.
